# rule assignee

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:ruleAssignee`](gmeow-ruleAssignee.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/ruleAssignee>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/rights`](../../slices/rights.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The party a rule applies to ([odrl:assignee](http://www.w3.org/ns/odrl/2/assignee)). Absent means the rule applies to everyone (an open offer to the public).

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to name the party a rule binds (the [odrl:assignee](http://www.w3.org/ns/odrl/2/assignee)) when a permission, prohibition, or duty applies to a specific agent rather than to everyone.

### Avoid when

- Avoid setting it for a public, open-offer rule (leave it absent — that means everyone) and avoid using it for the rights holder or licensor; those are [`gmeow:copyrightHolder`](gmeow-copyrightHolder.md) / [`gmeow:licensor`](gmeow-licensor.md).

### How to use

- Add one or more [`gmeow:ruleAssignee`](gmeow-ruleAssignee.md) agents to a rule (non-functional) when it is party-specific; omit it for an open offer to the public.

### Examples

- ex:mayReproduce [`gmeow:ruleAssignee`](gmeow-ruleAssignee.md) ex:acmeCorp.
